Game Overview

Tebo is a adventure title where guide the charming alien Tebo through a vibrant universe with strategic leaps and physics puzzles. With simple controls, navigate 50 intricate levels, mastering jumps and timing to avoid dangers. Each level is a new cerebral challenge, keeping you engaged in this colorful, thought-provoking adventure.
